title: LinguaScrape lexicon → canonical node/edge mapping
description: Deterministic, reviewable mapping from every lexicons/*.tsv to the canonical model defined in shared/canonical-schema.json (US-002). Each file declares a `kind`, its canonical `node` type (for node files), and a per-column disposition. Every source column is accounted for exactly once. Machine-readable sibling of the prose table in docs/canonical-schema.md §6.

kinds.node: Rows become canonical nodes of the declared `node` type.
kinds.edge: Rows become canonical edges (:START_ID/:END_ID/:TYPE columns present); `node` is null.
kinds.attribute: Describes properties of / attaches to a host node via a foreign key; not a standalone canonical node in v1. `node` is null. Columns retained as properties for a later ingestion pass.
kinds.excluded: Operational / presentation / asset table not part of the shared knowledge graph. `node` is null; all columns dropped.

dispositions.target: Column maps to a canonical field (a node field for node files, an edge field for edge files). Value must be a declared canonical field name.
dispositions.edge: Column encodes an embedded relationship extracted as a canonical edge (US-003). Value must be a canonical edge type name.
dispositions.property: Column has no dedicated canonical field but is retained as an extra Neo4j property / candidate for a future canonical field.
dispositions.drop: Column is not carried into the canonical model. Must carry a `reason`.
